x-runner-discovery.title: Retire unused release slot

x-runner-discovery.title: Request candidate sealing

reviews.when: The requested release slot is in your trusted organization and coordinator scope and is currently ready.
reviews.then: Propose retiring that slot; completion changes only its state to retired after separate supervised execution.
refused: Refuse if the slot is unavailable, outside the coordinator's trusted scope, or not ready.
Refuse if the slot changes before execution.
reviews.human_review: Every valid request requires release-supervisor review. Invalid requests are refused, not routed to review. Completion can occur only once execution is separately enabled and a worker is running.

examples.scenario: A coordinator requests retirement of a ready release slot assigned to that coordinator.
examples.result: The request is valid and is sent to release-supervisor review.

examples.scenario: A coordinator requests a consumed, retired, unavailable, or differently scoped slot.
A coordinator requests retirement of a ready scoped release slot.
examples.result: A release supervisor must approve before separately supervised completion can occur.

reviews.when: The coordinator's scoped candidate is staged with no security hold, its related reserved slot is ready, and the complete set of 2 to 12 checks has all passed with a total elapsed time of at most 600 seconds.
reviews.then: Propose sealing the candidate and consuming its related reserved slot together; completion remains separately supervised.
refused: Refuse if the candidate is not staged, has a security hold, the related slot is unavailable, any required relationship or check fact is missing or unknown, the check collection overflows, fewer than two checks exist, any check is not passed, total elapsed time exceeds 600 seconds, or dependency versions are stale.
reviews.human_review: A valid request with total check time above 50 seconds, or one that exceeds an automatic rolling limit, requires release-supervisor review. Invalid requests are refused and never routed to human review.

examples.scenario: A staged candidate without a hold has a ready slot and two passed checks totaling 50 seconds, within both automatic rolling limits.
examples.result: The sealing request is valid and eligible for automatic approval; supervised execution is still required before any change.

examples.scenario: A staged candidate without a hold has a ready slot and three passed checks totaling 180 seconds.
examples.result: The request is valid but requires release-supervisor review.

examples.scenario: A staged candidate has a ready slot, but one of its complete check records is pending.
